senses.gloss:
कित् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (केतति)
1 To desire.
--2 To live.
--3 (चिकित्सति) To heal,
cure.
--4 To doubt, suspect. {vII.v}
{c3c} P. Ved. (चिकेत्ति^1) To know.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 202605. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/226.

कितवः (वी f.)
1 A rogue, liar, cheat;
अर्हति किल कितव उपद्रवं M. 4;
Amaru. 17, 41; Me. 111.
--2 The Dhattūra
plant.
--3 A kind of perfume.
--4
A gamester, gambler.
--5 A mad or
crazy person.
